text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: [pager] HIGH: Elevated 5xx rate on gateway.redwood.ai (TLS handshake failures). Error type: 526/525 handshakes/timeouts. P50 latency spike -> paging oncall. 
Alice H: acknowledging. I'm oncall. digging in. can someone paste current 5xx/s and earliest spike?
Benji K: seeing spike started ~1798765400, 5xx rate from 0.6% -> 12% in ~3m. most errors are TLS handshake failures in front proxy logs: `tls: handshake error: tls: bad certificate` and `client_hello` timeouts.
Sam R: I ran a quick check against the edge via openssl:
```
openssl s_client -connect gateway.redwood.ai:443 -servername gateway.redwood.ai
```
Result: "Verify return code: 10 (certificate has expired)". the leaf cert returned is expired (not the intermediate).
Lee T: interesting — our mTLS agent rotated CA certs last night (deploy at 1798720000). deploy-bot, any deploys touching certs?
deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-10T03:12:45Z: infra/edge/cert-rotation (rolled to 4/5 hosts). No rollback recorded.
Maria S: customer-impact note: Support telemetry shows 28 customer sessions affected in last 10m; several enterprise customers report API failures and timeouts. SLO alert firing on request success rate.
Alice H: plan: 1) Validate which cert is expired and on which hosts 2) Stop strict mTLS check at edge (enable permissive mode) to restore traffic quickly 3) Route traffic to backup pool without the rotated cert while we rotate correct cert 4) Postmortem + permanent fix.
Benji K: quick host list and cert info: we see expiry on edge-proxy-3 (10.0.3.12) and edge-proxy-4 (10.0.3.13). Both returned leaf cert exp: Mar 9 02:00:00 2026 GMT. Others look fine.
Sam R: running fetch: `curl -vI https://10.0.3.12 --resolve gateway.redwood.ai:443:10.0.3.12` shows `SSL: certificate expired` in the TLS handshake phase.
Lee T: I can flip permissive mTLS on the edge policy. Command (edge-control):
```
edge-control set-policy gateway --mtls-mode permissive --targets edge-proxy-3,edge-proxy-4
```
This will stop rejecting clients without the full trust chain and let traffic flow. ETA ~30s.
Alice H: do it. also create a temporary routing rule to divert 50% traffic to gateway-backup-1 (same region) until certs are fixed. Use infra-route: 
```
infra-route promote --route gateway --targets gateway-backup-1 --weight 50
```
Benji K: permissive switch done. I see successful handshakes now from probes to edge-proxy-3. 5xx rate dropping from 12% -> 3% in last 2m.
SRE Pager: routing change applied, 50% to gateway-backup-1. health checks green.
Maria S: notifying top-tier customers via support banner and posting status page update draft: "We are investigating TLS handshake errors affecting some customers. Mitigation in progress." Should I send now?
Alice H: yes, publish now. include note about partial failover and that mitigation is ongoing.
Oncall Rotation: I will take the bridge for the next 2 hours and finish cert remediation. Handing over from Alice. Current mitigation: permissive mTLS + 50% diversion. Impact: API success rate back to 97%, some latency elevated.
Lee T: remediation steps I'm doing now: 1) re-issue new leaf certs signed by current CA 2) push to affected proxies 3) verify chain with `openssl s_client` 4) rotate back to strict mTLS. Pushing certs to edge-proxy-3/4 now.
Benji K: logs after push show `handshake complete` and cert expiry is now Mar 2027. Good. Running rolling restart on the two hosts to pick up the new certs.
Sam R: post-push validation: `openssl s_client -connect gateway.redwood.ai:443 -servername gateway.redwood.ai` -> Verify return code: 0 (ok). No more expired cert.
Alice H: once we've verified all edge nodes, revert permissive mode and remove diversion. Do that only after 5m of stable health.
Lee T: reverting policy now: `edge-control set-policy gateway --mtls-mode strict --targets all` -> done. Health checks stable for 6m.
SRE Pager: removing 50% diversion, routing set back to primary pool.
Maria S: published status update: "Mitigation: rollback of cert rotation and temporary permissive policy reduced errors. Services are recovering; no data loss. Engineering continuing validations."
Alice H: great. action items: (1) investigate why expired cert was issued / automation gap (owner: Lee) (2) ensure full rollout check before marking rotation complete (owner: deploy team) (3) add synthetic TLS expiry monitor to catch cert expiry 14d/7d (owner: SRE) (4) postmortem write-up due EOD tomorrow. I'll own the postmortem.
Oncall Rotation: taking ownership, will keep watch and update every 30m. Closing pager if stable for 30m. :white_check_mark: 
Alice H: thanks team. good mitigation here. we'll sync in postmortem. :raised_hands:
